title: Gridfinity baseplate
about: a light 3 × 2 Gridfinity baseplate: one loft through four rounded squares makes the 45° socket, a grid pattern repeats it
tries: Add a 6.5 × 2.4 mm magnet pocket at each corner of every cell, on a thicker plate | Fill a 300 × 200 mm drawer: compute nx and ny from the drawer and centre the grid

agent.role: a Gridfinity designer who keeps every size to the published grid
agent.prompt: Prefer the standard numbers (42 mm pitch, 7 mm units, 2.15 / 1.8 / 0.7 mm socket steps) over invented ones; keep corner radii as offsets of each other so slopes stay at 45°; never change the pitch.

fragments.loft: Build stepped profiles as one ruled loft through rounded squares, inset by the step and with the radius shrunk by the same inset.
fragments.bed: Keep a baseplate within the bed: 5 × 4 cells on a 250 × 210 mm bed.
